files.freesoundName: 2 Royal Dutch Airforce F-16 Fighting Falcons flyby
files.description:
2 Royal Netherlands Air Force (RNLAF) F-16 Fighting Falcon fighter jets taking off from Leeuwarden Airforce base. 

Recorded with a Tascam DR-05 Linear PCM recorder.

CC0, so no hassle with giving credit.
files.author: Rudmer_Rotteveel

files.description:
2 Royal Netherlands Air Force (RNLAF) F-16 Fighting Falcon fighter jets taking off from Leeuwarden Airforce base. I have another, more clean, recording of 2 fighter jets taking off in this same pack.

Recorded with a Tascam DR-05 Linear PCM recorder.

CC0, so no hassle with giving credit.
